{{Quote|Since the black hole warps all attempts to communicate outside the system, I suggest that these are all short-range messages, originating on Sebaddon.|[[Dao Stryver]]|<ref name="The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sebaddon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Sebaddon black hole]], [[Sebaddon]], and its [[Sebaddon's moon|moon]].

==Behind the scenes==
In [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]], Sebbadon was classified as part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618822|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:56 PM|quote=Yes, Oktos Sector is named for the nebula.}}</ref>
